displaySummary.zh: AI100（2022-2023）· 视觉 Transformer 缩放规律

displayDescription.en:
Scaling ViT studied Vision Transformers from roughly 5 million to 2 billion parameters, datasets from 1 million to 3 billion training images, and compute budgets from below one to more than 10,000 TPUv3 core-days. The authors found a saturating power-law relationship along the performance-compute frontier and emphasized that model capacity and compute must be scaled together rather than enlarging the model in isolation.

The work also refined the large-scale ViT training recipe with separate weight decay for the prediction head and body, memory-saving pooling in place of the class token, and a modified Adafactor optimizer. Its ViT-G/14 model reported 90.45% ImageNet top-1 accuracy and 84.86% in 10-shot linear evaluation; BenchCouncil lists Xiaohua Zhai, Alexander Kolesnikov and Lucas Beyer as the main contributors and associates the work with Google in Switzerland.
displayDescription.zh:
Scaling ViT 研究了约 500 万到 20 亿参数的视觉 Transformer、100 万到 30 亿张训练图像的数据规模，以及不足 1 到超过 1 万 TPUv3 core-days 的算力预算。作者发现性能与算力前沿近似遵循逐渐饱和的幂律关系，并强调模型容量与算力必须协同扩展，不能只孤立地增大模型。

该工作还改进了大规模 ViT 训练方案，包括为预测头和模型主体设置不同的权重衰减、用更节省内存的池化替代 class token，以及采用修改后的 Adafactor 优化器。其 ViT-G/14 报告了 90.45% 的 ImageNet top-1 准确率和 84.86% 的 10-shot 线性评估结果；BenchCouncil 将翟晓华、亚历山大·科列斯尼科夫和卢卡斯·拜尔列为主要人物，并将成果关联到瑞士的 Google。

html.en: After the original Vision Transformer showed that transformer encoders could compete with convolutional networks on image recognition, the next question was how ViT behaved when models, datasets and compute grew by orders of magnitude. Scaling ViT addressed that gap with a controlled family of experiments rather than assuming that language-model scaling observations would transfer unchanged to vision.
html.zh: 原始 Vision Transformer 证明 Transformer 编码器可以在图像识别上与卷积网络竞争后，下一个问题是当模型、数据集和算力跨数量级增长时，ViT 会如何变化。Scaling ViT 通过一组受控实验回答这一空白，而不是直接假设语言模型的缩放观察可以原样迁移到视觉领域。

html.en: The central result is a performance-compute frontier that is well approximated by a saturating power law when enough training data are available. Staying near that frontier requires scaling model capacity and compute together, while the revised head, pooling and optimizer choices make the largest ViT practical enough to fit and train on TPU hardware.
html.zh: 核心结果是：当训练数据充足时，性能与算力前沿可以由逐渐饱和的幂律较好近似。要保持接近这一前沿，模型容量和算力需要协同扩展；经过修改的预测头、池化方式和优化器则让最大规模 ViT 能够在 TPU 硬件上装入内存并完成训练。

html.en: Experts generally treat Scaling ViT as an early systematic scaling-law study for vision transformers and a practical bridge from the original ViT to billion-parameter vision backbones. Its conclusions are influential but deliberately bounded: the paper warns that the fitted relationships may not generalize beyond the studied scale or beyond the ViT family, making the work both a scaling guide and a model for stating empirical limits.
html.zh: 专家通常把 Scaling ViT 视为视觉 Transformer 早期具有系统性的缩放规律研究，也是从原始 ViT 走向十亿参数级视觉主干的重要实践桥梁。它的结论影响深远但边界明确：论文提醒这些拟合关系未必能推广到已研究规模之外或 ViT 家族之外，因此该工作既提供缩放指南，也示范了如何说明经验规律的适用限制。
